findings.evidence: Body at MomentSpace.lean:281 mentions only `S.alphaS`; `abbrev RunningCoupling : Type := ℝ → ℝ` at Evolution/Basic.lean:225, already imported (MomentSpace.lean:8) and used at MomentSpace.lean:541. Roadmap README.md:743-747 states the τ reparametrisation as a property of the coupling (Layer 3.3), used by Layer 3.5.
findings.fix: Take the coupling directly: `def integratedCoupling (αs : RunningCoupling) (τ₀ τ : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in τ₀..τ, αs (Real.exp s) / (2 * Real.pi)`, with `Continuous αs` as an explicit hypothesis on `_add`, `hasDerivAt_`, `strictMono_` (replacing the private `continuous_alphaS_exp_div`); `momentEvolution` then reads `NormedSpace.exp ((integratedCoupling S.alphaS τ₀ τ : ℂ) • S.gamma N)`.
findings.issue: `integratedCoupling (S : DglapMomentSystem ι) τ₀ τ : ℝ` uses only `S.alphaS`; `ι` and `S.gamma` are phantom. The whole reparametrisation block (`integratedCoupling_self/_add/_swap`, `hasDerivAt_integratedCoupling`, `strictMono_integratedCoupling`, lines 283-311) is thereby reachable only through a bundled moment system, so Layer 2.3/3.3 consumers holding a `RunningCoupling` (and no flavour index) cannot use any of it, and two systems sharing a coupling get unrelated `integratedCoupling` terms with no lemma identifying them.

findings.evidence: No `momentEvolution_def`/`integratedCoupling_def` in the file; the repo uses this pattern elsewhere, e.g. `theorem pairing_def` (Evolution/Kernel/NormalForm.lean:111) and `theorem moment_def` (NormalForm.lean:136).
findings.fix: Add `lemma momentEvolution_def (S) (N) (τ₀ τ) : momentEvolution S N τ₀ τ = NormedSpace.exp ((integratedCoupling S τ₀ τ : ℂ) • S.gamma N) := (rfl)` and `lemma integratedCoupling_def ... = ∫ s in τ₀..τ, ... := (rfl)`, and rewrite with them in place of the definition unfoldings.
findings.issue: Neither `momentEvolution` nor `integratedCoupling` has a `_def` restatement; every in-file proof unfolds the body (`rw [momentEvolution, ...]` at lines 332, 339, 346, 356; `rw [momentEvolution]` via `simp only` at 379). Downstream Layer 3.5 work (singlet diagonalisation, spectral projectors) must convert `momentEvolution` to `NormedSpace.exp (c • γ N)` to apply any exponential lemma, and can only do so by unfolding the definition.

summary: The new evolution-operator surface is well chosen and correctly annotated at the `_self` lemmas, but `integratedCoupling` and its five lemmas are facts about the running coupling alone, exposed only through a `DglapMomentSystem ι` whose index type is phantom, and neither new definition carries a `_def` restatement, so consumers must unfold the body.
